title:
If fetchSpec is present in the input: Transforms a JSON with new property `objs` that represents the expected
sensors. It also checks if the `availableExpectedSensors` does not contain each of the `expectedSensor`s in order to
determined if it's already used in sensor relation mapping.

If fetchSpec is not present in the input: Uses the same inputs to return the number of sensors.
name: ExpectedSensorNameGridTransform
